What a customize set actually contains, keyed by the sheet's own product string.

A set is one box holding several blades and a pile of loose ratchets and bits, but the sheet has only per-blade columns — so it spreads the loose parts across the blade rows, gives whichever blade is left over nothing, and parks the remainder on rows that are not blades at all. UX-10 is the worked example: three of its four blades carry one ratchet and one bit each, Hells Hammer carries nothing, bits R and P sit on two phantom 騎士圓甲改造組 rows (dropped via `skip` in partOverrides.json), and Metal Needle is missing entirely.

So the box is described here once and attached to every blade sharing that product string. `ratchets` and `bits` are the full contents; the detail sheet shows a blade's own assembled parts first and the rest under "Also in the box", so nothing here claims a blade ships built with all of them.

Sourced from the retailer's own assortment listing, which spells the contents out where the sheet does not.
